description.name: Zenith Mode: Alisaie (Wind, Lightning)
description.text: Increases [Lightning/Wind Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Lightning or Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Alisaie (Lightning, Wind) after using a Lightining or Wind ability (max 3), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Jolt+
description.text: Three single attacks (3.60  each), grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Impact+
description.text: Six single attacks (3.80/3.95 each), capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Alisaie (Lightning, Wind)
description.text: Four single attacks (2.60 each), grants [Magical Quick Cast 1] to user

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
